confirmed.place: Cancelled restart and the two following formulas
confirmed.checked: The restart remains cancelled and uncertain; On a remains live at medium confidence. The pi-zero formula has single angle brackets and a real slash in the quotient. The dfn label is retained. The pi-one formula keeps the source’s object-set argument and t, then pi-sub-t and its stabilisateur parenthesis; no expected alternative notation is supplied.

The live centralise is not independently struck. Phi(t)(T), subset and lower-case pi remain, followed by the baseline point. On suppose precedes one underline under T commutatif. The plain T has a cap and vertical stem distinct from the flag-top object-set letter.

The equality pi-sub-t=Phi-sub-t(T) is cancelled. The following Phi-sub-t:T isomorphism to pi-sub-t is live, with a visible arrowhead and tilde, followed by a separate dash. Phi(t) earlier and Phi-sub-t here remain distinct. No physical guide/caret accompanies this replacement.

Du is separately struck. The live prose has d’autres termes without a comma, donné with its comma, en plus de the object set, group-ens de pi-ens, ending in a descending comma. M0699 is de. No continuation was consulted. Graphite 20 at bottom left belongs to an unnamed hand.

Margins, line ends, cancellation strokes, underlining, parentheses, single angle brackets and map shafts were checked against the full original and native halves. No omitted insertion word, guide, caret or marginal note was identified. The full visible lower edge and pencil numeral were included.

All formula pi graphs on this page have the lower-case form, often with a rounded or inward-curving right leg. No capital Pi is substituted. All eleven flag-top object-set occurrences remain tau/calligraphic-T uncertainty. Both two-lobed group letters remain E/Sigma uncertainty. These are confirmations of existing rendering choices, not new material rows.

notes.text: The cancelled top text describes pi-torsors and their fibres, a stabilizer and Phi(t):T to pi. The second reading checks wording, indices, map and cancellation state. The source’s fibre/orbit notation remains uncertain; its mathematics is not used to supply a slash or an index.

The live action-groupoid account, morphism condition lambda t=t-prime and component/fundamental-group formulas were transcribed as written. The new low-confidence shaft/arrow alternative concerns only the tiny connector inside the morphism-set subscript. Its mathematical context does not establish a visibly absent head.

The source’s centralisation statement, underlined commutativity assumption, cancelled equality and live isomorphism are preserved. Phi(t) in the centralisation statement and Phi-sub-t in the replacement are distinct written forms. No mathematical validity check of these assertions was performed.

All four existing remaining doubts are retained unchanged; the indexed connector is a fifth. No existing collation row requires revised evidence or confidence, and no original MARK changes. Pure object-set and extension-letter alphabet questions do not create new material changes.

The final short word remains de under M0699; the source ends in pi-ens followed by a comma. No continuation was inspected. The bottom-left graphite 20 is attributed only to an unnamed hand. No omitted insertion guide or caret was found on this page.
